Preserve the original camera view, full 16:9 crop, framing, window details, raindrops, garden, books, lamp, mug, blanket and color grading exactly. Absolutely no remaining ghost of the person, no hair fragments, no human, no text. Do not recompose or zoom; maintain pixel alignment with the reference wherever possible. The empty seat should look like a real plausible part of the same room.
